docs.title: Architecture
docs.text:
Pipeline:

  1. Fetch market data (Massive + CBOE)
  2. Compute signals (Python)
  3. Classify market regime
  4. Generate AI summary (OpenAI)
  5. Generate charts (matplotlib)
  6. Update README
  7. Commit to repository

Design principles:

  • Deterministic signals
  • AI used only for narrative
  • Fully auditable via repo data

docs.title: Data Sources
docs.text:
• Massive (Polygon) for equities:
  • SPY
  • QQQ

  • ARKK

  • CBOE for volatility:

  • VIX historical dataset

All processed data is stored in:

  • data/signals.json
  • data/market_snapshot.json
  • data/history.json

docs.title: Recovery Signals
docs.text:
• SPY above 200-day moving average
  • QQQ above 100-day moving average
  • VIX below 20

docs.title: Context Signals
docs.text:
• TNX above 4 or below 3
  • OVX above 60 and below 90 with 78 just about perfect
